protocol.sequence: one Lisbon warm-up then three disjoint prompts, 227 uncached input and 64 generated tokens each, batch 1, temperature 0, speculation and thinking disabled
protocol.gpu_timing: Deltas of forward_execution_seconds_total for each tp_rank and phase. The reference phase duration is the maximum accumulated time from any rank over the entire request. It does not trace which rank was slowest on each step or measure wall-clock delivery. Phase rates use 227 inputs and 63 post-first-token steps.
protocol.client_timing: Monotonic time from sending the request to the first nonempty SSE text fragment, and from that fragment to the last nonempty fragment, measured independently of the GPU counters.
protocol.reproduce: Follow the SGLang guide with vf fetch --only libnccl, add --tp N to the server command, then run python3 sglang.py --tp-size N in the directory with prompts.json.

first_two_gpu_functional_check.timing_note: The original single-rank client summed both GPU timers, while token totals were emitted once. These observations establish functionality only.
